note: Togo: Moroccans enter without a visa for 90 days (bilateral) and nationals of every other African Union state for 30 (since 18 May 2026); everyone else applies for an e-Visa at least five days ahead (15, 30 or 90 days; Togo no longer issues visas on arrival). Every visitor fills in an immigration form 24 hours before arrival (not modelled). Read from Wikipedia's copy.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Visa policy of Togo
sources.said: Visitors to Togo must obtain an electronic visa, unless they come from one of the visa-exempt countries. ... Citizens of the following countries can visit Togo without a visa, for a stay up to the duration listed below: 30 days All African Union member states ... 21 July 2022: Morocco (bilateral, 90 days) 18 May 2026: All other African Union member states (unilateral, 30 days) ... Togo no longer issues visa on arrival and travelers from all countries must apply for eVisa instead.
